item.title: Shah Rukh Khan Praises Anil Kapoor's Performance in 'Subedaar'
item.description: Shah Rukh Khan Praises Anil Kapoor's Performance in 'Subedaar' Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan has lauded Anil Kapoor for his outstanding performance in the latest film 'Subedaar'.Directed by Suresh Triveni, the film was released on Prime Video on March 5, featuring an ensemble cast including Mona Singh and Saurabh Shukla.Khan expressed his admiration through social media, noting the unique character portrayals and exceptional action sequences.
